one_se_order.ElasticNet: largest relative penalty, then largest l1_ratio

stability.selection: full-data Lasso 1-SE relative penalty held fixed; alpha_max and scaling recomputed per subsample
stability.median_absolute_coefficient: all 100 resamples, including inactive values as zero
stability.ranking: selection frequency, median absolute standardized coefficient, full coefficient magnitude
stability.initialization: zero coefficients, independently for every subsample

gene_scaled_response: target-HSC divided by gene sample SD across 21 blood types excluding mDC
landmark_splits: intersection with the saved outer and inner gene lists
self_readout: remove matched own-gene rows, refit fixed relative Lasso 1-SE, inspect coefficient/sign and marginal correlation

correlation_groups.definition: connected components of thresholded perturbation correlations

extended_retuning: 20 resamples per target after stage 5, as planned

exploratory_size_control.sampling: non-landmark genes; exact landmark count in each outer test fold
exploratory_size_control.scope: training-set size/composition comparison; not part of prespecified model ranking
